title: discovery / reconnect / orphan GC / INSTANCE separation

acceptance_scenarios.intent: On palmux2 startup, scan the socket dir ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/palmux/<instancePrefix>/, fallback <config-dir>/run/), reconnect to live ptyhosts and restore tab state; clean up dead/unreachable sockets + status files.
acceptance_scenarios.test_kind: go integration (real ptyhost + Manager restore path)
steps: Start 2 real ptyhosts holding fake children, writing <repoId>__<branchId>__<tabId>.sock + .json into a temp socket dir.
Also drop a STALE socket+json whose recorded pid is dead (killed) and a socket that refuses connections.
Construct a Manager and run the startup discovery path pointed at the socket dir.
Assert the 2 live ptyhosts are re-adopted: Manager has Daemon entries in 'attach existing ptyhost' mode (HELLO handshake succeeds, no new spawn).
Assert the stale socket + json (dead pid) and the unreachable socket are removed from disk.
Assert a subsequent WS attach to a re-adopted tab replays the ring (screen restore, ties to AC-2-2).
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Live ptyhosts reconnected, dead ones GC'd, tab state restored.

acceptance_scenarios.intent: Tab delete / worktree removal / branch close sends SHUTDOWN to the corresponding ptyhost (claude terminated), via the existing 10s sync loop (tmux-zombie-kill parity).
steps: Adopt a live ptyhost for (repo,branch,tab) with the child alive.
Remove the corresponding tab/branch from the store (simulate worktree disappearance / branch close / CloseDaemon).
Run the orphan-GC reconciliation (the pass that rides the existing scanPorts/sync 10s loop): socket dir entries with no matching store (repo,branch,tab) → SHUTDOWN.
Assert a SHUTDOWN frame is sent, the ptyhost terminates the child (SIGTERM→SIGKILL) and exits, and the socket + json are cleaned up.
Assert a still-referenced ptyhost is NOT shut down (no false GC).
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Orphan ptyhosts are reaped like tmux zombies; referenced ones untouched.

acceptance_scenarios.intent: INSTANCE=dev ptyhosts are separated by instancePrefix; host and dev instances never claim/GC each other's ptyhosts (same guarantee as --tmux-prefix).
steps: Unit: assert the socket dir path embeds instancePrefix derived the same way as --tmux-prefix (default 'palmux', dev rig '_pmx_dev_' → sanitized subdir), and that discovery only scans this instance's subdir.
Unit: assert the systemd-run scope --unit name (Story 1) also embeds instancePrefix so scopes don't collide.

Integration/E2E: start a dev instance with a dev tmux-prefix and a second instance with a different prefix; each opens a claude-tui tab; assert instance A's startup discovery + orphan GC never touches instance B's sockets/ptyhosts (B's child stays alive when A does a full scan + GC).
acceptance_scenarios.expected: instancePrefix isolates socket dirs and scope names; no cross-instance claim/GC.

notes: Startup discovery lives in the Manager restore path (a new discover.go alongside manager.go). Orphan GC piggybacks the existing store 10s scanPorts loop (internal/store/sync_worktree.go) which needs a handle to the tui Manager (already partly wired: main.go struct has tuiMgr). instancePrefix should be derived from the same source that feeds domain.Configure(--tmux-prefix). Fallback dir <config-dir>/run/ must be 0700.
